snippet.title: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Sunflower and the Goddess of Death on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2748520/Sunflowers_and_the_Goddess_of_Death/ 

A retro-inspired turn-based RPG of faith, loss, and rebellion. Overcome the designs of a dread goddess, liberate your people, and shatter the chains that bind you.
